carried_minor_issues: [minor] I1 still fails for two turns whose prompts are identical, e.g. the same short retry such as '다시'. Both buttons then have the same name and the same description, so screen-reader users still cannot tell the turns apart. result.md does not list this edge case; it only mentions the 2000-char length concern.

[minor] aria-describedby does not change the accessible name. Voice-control users (who say 'click target 제작안 검토') still get two identical targets across turns. The original r1 finding listed voice control explicitly as a harm. The test openly asserts that the names repeat ('per-turn names may repeat across turns').

[minor] Real-browser verification is still missing. Nobody has observed the 375px focus order (whether the preview tab is skipped), the arrival outline visibility and clipping, or screen-reader output for describedby. The 8 headless-Chrome Python modules and work_status.cjs were also not re-run after the r2 changes, by me or by the worker. A static grep of those browser tests found no assertion on the changed selectors or attributes, so I estimate the regression risk as low, but this is [추정].
